lessonsIntro: We have not yet confirmed a surf school that teaches at Beadnell Bay itself. Northside Surf School runs lessons nearby at Bamburgh.

text: Beadnell Bay is a broad sandy bay on the north Northumberland coast. Living North reports that one local school, Surf Northumberland, holds most of its lessons at Newton Steads at the southern end of the bay, but we could not confirm the location or current trading on the school's own website, so we have left it out for now.

If you want a confirmed lesson nearby, Northside Surf School teaches a few miles north at Bamburgh and supplies all the kit. Whichever beach you choose, the North Sea is cold and conditions change quickly, so learning with an instructor is the safest way to start.

cards.title: Learn with a school
cards.text: Book a lesson nearby until a Beadnell-based school is confirmed.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Summer
cards.text: The water is at its warmest in late summer; plan any lesson around the instructors' advice on the day.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Cold water
cards.text: This is the North Sea: wear a thick suit and never surf alone.

hireIntro: We have not confirmed surfboard hire at Beadnell. Living North lists KA Adventure Sports here for SUP, kitesurfing and wingsurfing.

text: For a first go, a long soft-top is the most forgiving board on any sandy bay like Beadnell. The sea here is cold for much of the year, so a 5/4mm suit with boots is a sensible baseline, with gloves and a hood in winter.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Big foam board to start
cards.text: Northside supplies boards on its lessons. If you are new, stay on a large soft-top until you can catch and ride green waves.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 5/4mm most of the year
cards.text: North Sea water stays cool. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm suits and treats them as year-round wear, adding boots, gloves and a hood in the colder months.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Kite, wing and SUP
cards.text: Beadnell is known for wind sports; Living North lists SUP, kitesurf and wingsurf lessons and hire here.

shopsIntro: We could not confirm a surf shop in Beadnell.
shopsText: We have not found a surf shop in Beadnell village. Bring your own wetsuit and accessories, or buy before you travel; Northside Surf School's base at Amble is the nearest confirmed surf business to the south.
